title: The Train That Wouldn’t Wait
custom_script:
# Scene: Railway Station
Peddy: Hurry up, Teddy! The *train* is leaving in two minutes! {run} [surprised, wave, shout, horn]
Teddy: {ohoo} Relax! My shoe lace was *untied*. {pace} [calm, shrug, giggle]
Peddy: {gasp} Look at the *clock*! It's moving too fast! {point} [surprised, point, excited, ding]
Teddy: {hmm} Impossible. Clocks don't have *legs*. {shake-head} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {look:clock} It literally just winked at us! {shock} [surprised, point, gasp]
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {walk-to} Let's ask the *station master* over there. {point} [calm, point]
Peddy: {wave} Excuse us! When does this *train* depart? {shout} [excited, wave, shout]
Station Master: {angry} Right now! And you missed it by *ten* seconds! {point} [angry, point, shout, horn]
Teddy: {ohoo} No way! We have our *tickets* right here! {show:basket} [surprised, shrug, ohoo]
Station Master: {laugh} Tickets don't matter if the *train* is already flying! {point} [happy, idle, laugh]
Peddy: {shock} Flying?! Since when do *trains* fly?! {gasp} [surprised, point, gasp]
# Time skip: Five minutes later…
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {sit:bench} Well, that's great. Now we're stuck at the *station*. {sigh} [sad, shrug, fail]
Peddy: {pace} We cannot just sit here! We have a *journey* to finish! {angry} [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {idea} {light-fire} Let's make *tea* using the station khokha! {clap} [excited, point, ding]
Shopkeeper: {angry} Hey! That's my private *stove*! {point} [angry, point, shout, slap]
Peddy: {oops} Sorry, mister! We are just desperate *travelers*! {sweat} [surprised, shrug, oops]
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {drink} Ah, this tea is actually quite *good*. {smile} [happy, idle, sip]
Peddy: {angry} Stop drinking and help me push this *crate*! {push} [angry, point, shout]
Teddy: {ha} Push it where? The *tracks* are empty! {shout} [surprised, shrug]
Peddy: {look-around} Wait… where did the *train* go? {gasp} [surprised, look-around, gasp]
Shopkeeper: {laugh} It left for the *mountains* an hour ago! {point} [happy, idle, laugh]
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {facepalm} An hour ago?! But you said *ten* seconds! {cry} [sad, shrug, fail, cry]
Station Master: {wink} Time flies when you're having *fun* at the station! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
Peddy: {angry} This isn't fun, this is a *nightmare*! {shout} [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {idea} Look, a stray *dog* is sleeping on the platform! {point} [surprised, point, ding]
Peddy: {sniff} What does a sleeping *dog* have to do with our train? {hmm} [suspicious, think]
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {wake} Maybe he knows the *shortcut* through the hills! {jump} [excited, point, boing]
Dog: {bark} Woof! Follow me, you *fools*! {run} [excited, idle, shout]
Peddy: {gasp} Did that *dog* just speak English?! {shock} [surprised, point, gasp]
Teddy: {run} Who cares! Run after the *dog*! {chase} [excited, point, shout, footsteps]
Peddy: {huff} I'm too out of shape for this *adventure*! {sweat} [sad, shrug, phew]
# Time skip: Ten minutes later…
# Scene: Railway Station
Teddy: {climb:water tank} I can see the whole *village* from up here! {point} [excited, point, wow]
Peddy: {shout} Get down before you fall off that *tank*! {fear} [angry, point, shout]
Teddy: {slip} Whoops! I'm slipping on the *metal*! {fall} [surprised, point, crash]
Peddy: {catch} I got you! Grab my *hand*! {pull} [surprised, point, gasp]
Teddy: {yay} Safe! Thanks for not letting me *crash*. {hug} [happy, wave, yay]
# Scene: Railway Station
Shopkeeper: {give:mango} Here, take this *mango* and stop making noise. {smile} [happy, idle, sip]
Peddy: {eat:mango} Mmm, surprisingly delicious! Free *food* is the best. {yum} [happy, idle, eat]
Teddy: {look-around} Wait, listen… do you hear that *sound*? {hmm} [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {gasp} It's the *train* coming back! {point} [surprised, point, gasp, horn]
Teddy: {jump} Quick, grab our *bags*! {run} [excited, point, yay, boing]
# Scene: Railway Station
Peddy: {open:door} Open the coach *door*, it's stopping! {push} [excited, point, shout, door]
Train: {horn} Toot toot! All aboard the *express*! {shout} [excited, idle, horn]
Teddy: {enter:hut} We made it! Inside the *train* at last! {yay} [happy, wave, yay]
Peddy: {sit} Never running for a *train* ever again. {sigh} [calm, idle, phew]
Teddy: {laugh} Until the next *episode*, anyway! {wink} [happy, wave, laugh]
# Scene: Railway Station
Dog: {bark} Don't leave me behind, *guys*! {run} [excited, idle, shout]
Peddy: {oops} Oh look, our favorite *dog* wants to come too! {point} [surprised, point, oops]
Teddy: {pull} Quick, pull him inside the *window*! {help} [excited, point, slap]
Dog: {smile} Thanks, humans! This *train* is awesome! {yay} [happy, idle, yay]
Peddy: {laugh} Best *railway station* trip ever! {cheer} [happy, wave, applause]
